Directorist Polylang Directory Type mapping — local verification
Date: 17 October 2026
Site: http://support-test.local/
Environment: Directorist 8.10.4, Polylang 3.8.11, PHP 8.2.27, Twenty Twenty-Four.

PR packaging verification
The fix was applied without conflicts to sovware/directorist trunk at
cfd22c84763155700b53a2d029b94754097fbd79. PHPCS (the repository standard, with
warning severity 0), PHP syntax checks and git diff --check passed. The existing
listing-import-taxonomy-cache.php and listing-taxonomy-subterms.php regression
tests passed. The only additional core changes during packaging are formatting:
the new multi-line get_terms call and four pre-existing tab-indented badge lines
were normalized for PHPCS. The functional local test results below were collected
during implementation, before the synthetic fixtures were removed.

Result
The mapping fix is applied to the active local Directorist source. It resolves
Directory Type IDs/slugs to the current language for All Listings and Search
Listing, including Gutenberg rendering, shortcodes and AJAX requests. It also
copies/translates protected _directory_type metadata through Polylang and keeps
listing meta and Directory Type taxonomy aligned during saves and language changes.

Changed source files (relative to wp-content/plugins/directorist/)
- includes/classes/class-multilingual-polylang.php
- includes/model/Listings.php
- includes/model/SearchForm.php

Baseline
Synthetic linked English/French Directory Types, taxonomy terms and listings were
created on the requested site. Each language had three listings. French listings
had French taxonomy but stale English _directory_type metadata, matching the ticket.
Copied English Directory Type references rendered a blank French block. The initial
regression run exited 1 with four failed French assertions: selected directory,
results, pagination and AJAX ID mapping. English assertions passed.

Verification after the fix
36 regression assertions passed in the final run, covering:
- English and French copied Directory Type references.
- Three results per language with two listings per page and two total pages.
- AJAX source-language references provided as numeric IDs and slugs.
- Persisted listing meta matching the listing language and taxonomy.
- Valid slug/ID translation and unchanged values for missing translations,
  invalid IDs and non-Directory-Type taxonomy IDs.
- Actual Polylang metadata-copy lifecycle, including the protected meta key.
- Metadata writes after language assignment and later language changes.
- Normal WordPress post saves and idempotent repair calls.
- Standalone Search Listing and archive filter forms.
- Multiple Directory Type references and preservation of unrelated attributes.

Browser checks
- English Gutenberg block: three English results; French results excluded.
- French Gutenberg block: three French results; English results excluded.
- French shortcode: three French results with mapped Directory Type ID 753.
- French AJAX keyword + category filter: Gamma returned one French Clinic Gamma.
- Clear All restored the three French results.
- French page 2: one French Clinic Gamma; pagination current page 2.
- English page 2: one English Clinic Gamma; pagination current page 2.
- No JavaScript page exceptions were reported in the final browser check.
The site's existing missing image assets were visible; this patch does not replace
site media or alter its presentation.

Repair utility
repair-polylang-directory-types.php defaults to a dry run and processes 200 listings
per batch. One synthetic stale row was introduced directly for this test. Dry run
reported 1 candidate without changing its English ID. Apply repaired 1 listing;
a second dry run reported 0 candidates. The full regression suite passed afterward.
Back up a target database before running apply. The utility does not modify listing
content; it updates the Directory Type meta and taxonomy relationship only.

Additional checks
- PHP syntax checks passed for all three changed files and the repair utility.
- With Polylang skipped, the existing Catalogo archive returned its original
  Directory Type ID 493 and twelve listing results; mapping filters were absent.
- git apply --reverse --check succeeded against the installed modified files.
- The local homepage returned HTTP 200 after cleanup.

Cleanup and evidence limits
The site's original Polylang configuration had no languages. The temporary English
and French languages, synthetic listings/pages and fixture taxonomy terms were
removed after QA. The original empty-language configuration and infinite_scroll
pagination setting were restored and verified. The temporary query diagnostic was
removed. The task's Agent Browser session was explicitly closed; doctor and session
listing confirmed that t3355-polylang was no longer active. Pre-existing sessions
were left intact. The code fix remains installed locally.

Testing used synthetic data on the requested local site, not the client's WPvivid
backup. The patch was generated against this site's pre-change files, preserving
its pre-existing custom source changes. Review against the target repository before
release. A normal plugin update can overwrite these local core modifications.

Artifacts
- tools/repair-polylang-directory-types.php: dry-run/apply utility for existing data.
- .github/pr-assets/teamsync-3355-fr-search.png: filtered French browser result.
- .github/pr-assets/teamsync-3355-fr-pagination.png: French page 2 result.
- .github/pr-assets/teamsync-3355-en-block.png: English Gutenberg result.

Repair usage (from a WordPress shell after applying the source fix)
wp eval-file /absolute/path/to/repair-polylang-directory-types.php
wp eval-file /absolute/path/to/repair-polylang-directory-types.php apply
